objective: Resolve every known NodeRoom product and proof limitation without weakening behavior or certification gates.
completionRule: Every required gate must be passed and every remaining gap must be classified as an intentional boundary.

gates.claimBoundary: One stable official V2 exact pass and one local modification-score lift; no full-suite rerun claim.
Free-provider uptime is external; bounded failover, cooldown, transparent resolution, and live recovery are proven.
Safe and isolated Pyodide lanes are live-proven; optional Jupyter/container gateways are contract-tested and require separately configured approved infrastructure.

External Neo4j synchronization requires an explicitly configured service; the shared graph contract, adapters, clustering, path ranking, pinning, filtering, dragging, and large-graph behavior are proven locally.

intentionalBoundaries: Free-provider uptime is external; bounded attempts, transparent recovery, and permitted deterministic fallbacks are product obligations.
Arbitrary notebook code never runs in the application process; network is denied by default and external kernels require isolation and approval.
External Neo4j, Jupyter, and container services require explicit configuration and credentials.
Official fixtures, checklists, and scorers are immutable and cannot be self-promoted by the exploration loop.
Scoped official results remain scoped until a full-suite official rerun is accepted.
The accepted SpreadsheetBench V2 full-suite result remains 0/321 exact passes; the separate Task 90 receipt is a scoped 3/3 visual-judge stability proof.
Guest-observer memory-mode dogfood proves the observer workflow perspective; live guest-role enforcement is certified separately.
